list.title: What happens
list.sub: People built from your records react to a situation, round by round. You read what they said and who changed their mind.
list.emptyBody: A scenario is a small simulated social network. People are built from what your workspace already knows — files, prospects, comments on your posts, the company profile — and react to a situation you describe over several rounds: posting, replying, changing their minds. You get the feed, the people and a report of what moved them. It is something to think with, not a forecast.
